title: Zun`Muram Kvxe Pirik
summary: Balance four aspects during Kvxe's meditation to prevent permanent increases in his power.
overview: Balance four aspects during Kvxe's meditation to prevent permanent increases in his power.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Split damage across the four aspects and stop damage when each enters its correct band.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: From 90% through 30% health in ten-point steps, Kvxe enters a 70-second meditation.
Bring each of the four balance NPCs into the current target health band. The messages announce when a scale tips in your favor or falls out of balance.
An unbalanced aspect increases the boss's attack speed, armor, melee damage or attack rating.
At 20% he accelerates again for the finish.

notes: Approval E334. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
